regions.caption: Tiny Speck’s own painting of Vantalu, restored from its 2012 Encyclopedia map: the painting with the game’s roads, names and buttons on it. An image model took those markings off and sharpened it without moving anything, then it was toned back to the 2012 colour.
regions.differences: The cliff bands, the two dark slots in the rock, the small cave holes, the stepping stones, the ledges under Quozee Quanta, Masquff Greets and Jameeda Meds, every bush clump and the stones in the meadow sit where 2012 had them (worst tile drift 4 px at 2x). Known differences: the wide pale rock ledge that sticks out of the cliff under Gersal Gemony, with its shadowed underside, is gone except for a thin sliver, bare cliff wall in its place; along Mutta Maart, where 2012 has a short ledge ending before the M and then dark rock with a long dark slot under the name, one long raised ledge runs on from that short ledge to the stepping stones at Balleet Berm, and the slot shrank to a small cave arch behind it.

regions.name: Vortex of Random
regions.caption: Tiny Speck’s own painting of Vortex of Random. Its 2012 Encyclopedia map is the same painting as The Seams’s, with this region’s roads, names and buttons on it, so it shares The Seams’s restore: an image model sharpened The Seams’s 2012 map without moving anything, then it was fitted to this map’s frame and toned back to the 2012 colour.
regions.differences: The Seams' painting, restored, under Vortex of Random's roads and names: its 2012 map is that painting with them on top, so nothing here was painted for Vortex. The green wormhole grid and its two planes, the funnel with its bright yellow-green waist, the green lettering along the funnel's rim, the two faint ghost funnels at the left and right, and the bright stars with their sparkles sit where Vortex's 2012 map has them (worst tile drift 2 px at 2x). Known differences, The Seams' own: the grid lines are crisp and evenly bright where 2012's glow softly and fade into the dark toward the right of both planes; the ghost funnels are clearer than 2012's faint ones; the dark sky carries many more tiny stars than 2012 and less of its soft brown haze; the lettering along the rim is redrawn in the same style, and neither copy reads as words. From fitting it to Vortex's frame, which shows the painting a little smaller: the outermost 2 to 4 rows and columns at 2x on the left, right and bottom repeat the row or column beside them. The faint pale road traces Vortex's 2012 map shows across the bottom plane are its markings and are not painted.

regions.name: Xalanga
regions.caption: Tiny Speck’s own painting of Xalanga, restored from its 2012 Encyclopedia map: the painting with the game’s roads, names and buttons on it. An image model took those markings off and sharpened it without moving anything, then it was toned back to the 2012 colour.
regions.differences: The savanna, its rocks and boulders, the shrubs, the small pond, the two big rock outcrops and the faint darker patches of grass between the roads (near Distant Drag B, Hazy Gate 5, Ardent Ave 4 and Deadpan Dike 3) sit where 2012 had them (worst tile drift 2 px at 2x). Known differences: six small dark hollows, soft dark grey patches in the grass beside street names, lost their look: five are gone (just right of the end of Zealous Rd W, under the start of Languid Line W, just right of Hazy Gate 1, under Languid Line S, and just right of the end of Distant Drag D) and the one under Tack of Fervor Tack C came back as a pale stone.

regions.name: Zhambu
regions.caption: Tiny Speck’s own painting of Zhambu, restored from its 2012 Encyclopedia map: the painting with the game’s roads, names and buttons on it. An image model took those markings off and sharpened it without moving anything, then it was toned back to the 2012 colour.
regions.differences: The savanna, its darker grass mounds, the small blue pool with its bushes, every scrub clump, the boulders at the bottom left and by To: Baqala, the rock outcrops at the top right and the small stones sit where 2012 had them (worst tile drift 2 px at 2x), and no road ghosts show with the contrast raised. Known differences: two small dark hollows in the grass just above the start of the words 'Rube's Way 3', below where Boor Bane C meets Boor Bane D, are gone (plain grass there); the darker grass mounds by Chuff Chase 3, Swain Way 4 and Rustic Rd NE are a little softer and lighter than 2012's; along the top edge, where the model copied the 2012 Encyclopedia's thin white frame, the outermost rows were filled from the row beside them, so the bushes the edge cuts show a few pixels of streaks at 2x.
